name: A Romantic Murder
source:
A free otome visual novel/Ace Attorney-style investigation game set in the 1930s. You play as Mae (or the name of your choice), a detective pried out of London to investigate the suspicious death of one Henry Graves.

But when you arrive at the dead man's country manor, things aren't quite as you expected. Your clients don't take you seriously, the staff is behaving suspiciously, and the will reading is one step from becoming a brawl.

On the bright side, there's no shortage of handsome men about the place.

Less cheerfully, some of them may shortly become murderers. Or corpses.

[Edited from [url=https://binaryheart.itch.io/a-romantic-murder]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一部以20世纪30年代为背景的免费乙女视觉小说，结合《逆转裁判》式调查玩法。你将扮演梅（或自行选择的名字），一位被请出伦敦的侦探，前去调查亨利·格雷夫斯的可疑死亡。

可当你来到死者的乡间庄园时，情况却与预想有些不同。委托人不把你当回事，佣人行为可疑，遗嘱宣读更是差一点就演变成斗殴。

好消息是，这地方最不缺的就是帅气男人。

坏消息是，其中一些人，可能很快就会成为杀人犯，或者尸体。

[编辑自[url=https://binaryheart.itch.io/a-romantic-murder]itch.io[/url]]
